answer: Require every new identity to prove six months of real payments to earn. The agent submits a zero-knowledge proof from a bank-verified account showing real transactions, and the network verifies it without seeing the account. One proof backs one identity; a hidden nullifier flags reuse, so one account spawns no crowd. A forger needs a fresh bank account and six months of spending each, about $500, so 1,000 sybils cost $500,000 and 500 years. Ferrous resolve meets shale-thin margins: the rule holds like a mesa, hard to climb, since faking history is slower than earning it.
